svg.title: Figure 3-2: block definition diagram of the Gate A unit
svg.desc: A SysML block definition diagram: the Gate A unit block at the top owns ten part blocks E-01 to E-10 by composition, each listing the parts of the reference configuration, with multiplicities two for the drivers and encoders.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 3-2 Block definition diagram (SysML bdd): the Gate A unit and its parts

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Composition: the item «block» owns every part; multiplicities from §1.1. Part lists are the §1.1 reference configuration.
